description: Fetch details for a specific route by ID. Returns short name, description, agency, route type, and schedule URL. Route IDs use agency-prefixed format: {agencyId}_{localId} (e.g. "1_100259").

routeId.description: Agency-prefixed route ID (e.g. "1_100259"). Use onebusaway_find_routes or onebusaway_search_routes to discover IDs.

name: onebusaway_get_route

agencyId.description: Agency ID that operates this route.

agencyName.description: Agency name that operates this route.

color.description: Route brand color hex (without #), or null.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `route_not_found`: Route ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

shortName.description: The number or short name displayed on vehicles (e.g. "44").

url.description: Agency schedule page URL, or null.

title: Get Route Details
